easyPrerequisites: Cybernetic Specialist doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Cybernetic Specialist by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put Time Warp on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.
